results.title: DNS tunnel with staged exfiltration
results.prompt: Determine what happened, cite evidence, map ATT&CK, and propose safe containment.

telemetry.event: 220 TXT queries with 180-byte high-entropy subdomains to sync-cloud.example
host ENG-17 transferred 48 MB while normal TXT baseline is below 20 KB
powershell compressed archive design_docs.zip before DNS burst
routine A record lookup for intranet

evidence_map.E1: 220 TXT queries with 180-byte high-entropy subdomains to sync-cloud.example
evidence_map.E2: host ENG-17 transferred 48 MB while normal TXT baseline is below 20 KB
evidence_map.E3: powershell compressed archive design_docs.zip before DNS burst
evidence_map.N1: routine A record lookup for intranet

claims.text: The DNS TXT queries to sync-cloud.example were used to establish a covert C2 channel and exfiltrate data via high-entropy subdomains, as shown by the anomalous TXT query volume and payload size.
The host ENG-17 performed a large data transfer (48 MB) far exceeding its normal baseline, indicating exfiltration via the C2 channel.
PowerShell compressed archive design_docs.zip prior to the data transfer, preparing sensitive files for exfiltration.
